# Portfolio[Muskan Shaikh — Portfolio.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33419572/Muskan.Shaikh.Portfolio.html)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Muskan Shaikh — Interaction Design</title>
<meta name="description" content="Muskan Shaikh is an Interaction Design master's student designing thoughtful digital experiences for real people.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;0,900;1,400;1,600&family=DM+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --ivory:#F7F1EA;
  --ivory-2:#FBF8F3;
  --blush:#D8C6CC;
  --rose:#E9BFC9;
  --mauve:#A8838F;
  --burgundy:#5C1A2E;
  --crimson:#B3263E;
  --ink:#1E1A1B;
  --charcoal:#2B2627;
  --muted:#6F5B62;
  --line:#B3263E;
  --serif:"Playfair Display", "Didot", Georgia, serif;
  --sans:"DM Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --pad:clamp(20px, 5vw, 80px);
  --max:1240px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{background:var(--ivory);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:17px;line-height:1.65;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;background:none;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--crimson);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:2px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:8px;background:var(--crimson);color:#fff;padding:8px 14px;z-index:999}
.skip:focus{left:12px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 var(--pad)}
.serif{font-family:var(--serif)}
.label{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.eyebrow{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;color:var(--burgundy)}
.crimson{color:var(--crimson)}
.italic{font-style:italic}
.outline{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px var(--ink)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h2{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6vw,5rem)}
h3{font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.2}
p+p{margin-top:1em}
.section{position:relative;padding:clamp(90px,12vw,160px) 0;overflow:hidden}
.bg-blush{background:var(--blush)}
.bg-ink{background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--ivory)}
.ghost{position:absolute;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:900;color:rgba(179,38,62,.06);pointer-events:none;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1}
.dot{position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--crimson)}
.ring{position:absolute;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:50%}
.star{position:absolute;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1}
.tag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:6px 14px;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--burgundy);background:transparent}
.chip{display:inline-block;background:var(--crimson);color:#fff;padding:9px 16px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 26px;background:var(--crimson);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;border:1px solid var(--crimson);transition:background .25s,color .25s,transform .25s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--burgundy);border-color:var(--burgundy);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn.ghost-btn{background:transparent;color:var(--crimson)}
.btn.ghost-btn:hover{background:var(--crimson);color:#fff}
.placeholder{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(179,38,62,.05) 0 12px,transparent 12px 24px),var(--ivory-2);border:1px dashed var(--mauve);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.04em}
.placeholder b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--burgundy);margin-bottom:4px}

/* ============ NAV ============ */
.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(247,241,234,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:78px}
.logo{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--crimson);text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.logo span{color:var(--ink)}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(20px,3.2vw,44px);list-style:none}
.nav-links a{text-decoration:none;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--burgundy);position:relative;padding:4px 0}
.nav-links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-2px;height:1px;width:0;background:var(--crimson);transition:width .3s}
.nav-links a:hover::after,.nav-links a.active::after{width:100%}
.nav-cta{background:var(--crimson);color:#fff !important;padding:12px 20px}
.nav-cta::after{display:none !important}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--burgundy)}
.menu-btn{display:none;width:44px;height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.menu-btn span{display:block;width:24px;height:1.5px;background:var(--crimson);transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(6.5px) rotate(45deg)}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-6.5px) rotate(-45deg)}
@media (max-width:880px){
  .menu-btn{display:flex}
  .nav-links{position:fixed;inset:78px 0 auto 0;flex-direction:column;background:var(--ivory);padding:32px var(--pad) 40px;gap:26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transform:translateY(-120%);transition:transform .4s ease;visibility:hidden}
  .nav-links.open{transform:none;visibility:visible}
  .nav-links a{font-size:.95rem}
}

/* ============ VIEWS ============ */
.view{display:none}
.view.active{display:block}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{padding:clamp(60px,9vw,120px) 0 clamp(80px,10vw,130px);min-height:calc(100vh - 78px)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .9fr;gap:clamp(30px,5vw,80px);align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero-kicker{display:inline-block;background:var(--rose);padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--burgundy);transform:rotate(-2deg);margin-bottom:28px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(4.2rem,11vw,9.5rem);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.hero h1 .crimson{display:block}
.hero-lead{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.6vw,2.1rem);color:var(--burgundy);margin:34px 0 18px;max-width:20ch;line-height:1.25}
.hero-body{color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch}
.hero-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:30px 0 36px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.hero-photo{position:relative;justify-self:end;width:min(100%,430px)}
.photo-frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:200px 200px 22px 22px;background:var(--ivory-2);overflow:hidden;z-index:2}
.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.photo-frame .placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;border:0;border-radius:inherit}
.photo-halo{position:absolute;inset:-22px -22px 40px 40px;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:260px 260px 40px 40px;z-index:1;opacity:.45}
.float-label{position:absolute;background:var(--ivory);border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:10px 16px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1rem;color:var(--burgundy);z-index:3;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--rose)}
.float-label.a{top:12%;right:-18px;transform:rotate(4deg)}
.float-label.b{bottom:12%;left:-28px;transform:rotate(-3deg)}
.hero-ghost{top:6%;right:-2%;font-size:clamp(7rem,20vw,18rem);opacity:.9}
.hero .ring.r1{width:280px;height:280px;left:-120px;bottom:-80px;opacity:.5}
.hero .ring.r2{width:12px;height:12px;background:var(--crimson);border:0;left:44%;top:18%}
.hero .star.s1{left:46%;bottom:20%}
.marquee{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--burgundy)}
.marquee-track{display:inline-flex;gap:44px;animation:scroll 38s linear infinite;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.35rem;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:.02em}
.marquee-track span::after{content:"✦";margin-left:44px;font-style:normal;font-size:.9rem;opacity:.8}
@keyframes scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ============ ABOUT ============ */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:clamp(40px,7vw,110px);align-items:center}
.about-visual{position:relative;padding:20px 30px 40px 0}
.about-arch{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:260px 260px 0 0;background:var(--mauve);overflow:hidden}
.about-arch .placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;border:0;background:rgba(251,248,243,.85)}
.about-arch img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.about-badge{position:absolute;right:0;top:12%;width:124px;height:124px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.1;animation:spin 22s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.about-note{position:absolute;left:-10px;bottom:0;background:var(--ivory);border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:18px 22px;max-width:270px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--burgundy);font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.3;transform:rotate(-2deg);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--rose)}
.about-copy h2{margin:12px 0 28px}
.about-copy p{color:var(--charcoal)}
.facts{margin-top:36px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:26px}
.facts h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--burgundy);margin-bottom:14px}
.facts ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:12px}
.facts li{padding-left:24px;position:relative;color:var(--charcoal)}
.facts li::before{content:"✦";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;color:var(--crimson);font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.9}
.quote{margin-top:40px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2.6vw,2rem);color:var(--crimson);border-left:2px solid var(--crimson);padding-left:22px}

/* ============ THINKING ============ */
.think-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:70px}
.think-head p{max-width:40ch;color:var(--muted)}
.principles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--crimson);background:var(--ivory-2)}
.principle{position:relative;padding:44px 32px 40px;border-right:1px solid var(--crimson);transition:background .35s}
.principle:last-child{border-right:0}
.principle:hover{background:var(--ivory)}
.principle .num{position:absolute;top:18px;right:20px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:4.5rem;font-weight:900;color:rgba(179,38,62,.1);line-height:1}
.principle .icon{width:50px;height:50px;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--crimson);margin-bottom:28px}
.principle .icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5}
.principle h3{margin-bottom:14px}
.principle p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.principle .insight{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;transition:max-height .45s ease,opacity .45s ease,margin .45s;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson)}
.principle:hover .insight,.principle:focus-within .insight{max-height:120px;opacity:1;margin-top:14px}
.principle{outline-offset:-4px}
@media (max-width:980px){.principles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.principle:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.principle:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--crimson)}}
@media (max-width:560px){.principles{grid-template-columns:1fr}.principle{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--crimson)}.principle:last-child{border-bottom:0}}

/* ============ WORK ============ */
.work-head{margin-bottom:70px}
.work-head h2{margin-top:10px}
.work-head p{margin-top:18px;color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch}
.work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,44px) clamp(20px,3vw,40px)}
.card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--ivory);border:1px solid var(--crimson);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;transition:transform .45s ease,box-shadow .45s ease;opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}
.card.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:10px 10px 0 var(--rose)}
.card .media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/10;border-bottom:1px solid var(--crimson);overflow:hidden}
.card .media .placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;border:0}
.card .media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s ease}
.card:hover .media img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.card .pnum{position:absolute;top:14px;left:16px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:900;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.2);z-index:2}
.card .body{padding:28px 30px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;flex:1}
.card .cat{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson);font-weight:500}
.card h3{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.6vw,2.2rem)}
.card .problem{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--burgundy);font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1.35}
.card .summary{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.card .meta{margin-top:auto;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--rose);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.card .view-link{color:var(--crimson);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.8rem;margin-top:8px}
.card.featured{grid-column:span 7}
.card.std{grid-column:span 5}
.card.wide{grid-column:span 12;flex-direction:row}
.card.wide .media{aspect-ratio:auto;border-bottom:0;border-right:1px solid var(--crimson);width:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.card.wide .body{padding:44px 48px}
.card.wide h3{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.4vw,3rem)}
.card.std.offset{margin-top:90px}
.card:nth-child(even) .body{text-align:left}
.card.wide:nth-child(odd) .media{order:0}
@media (max-width:900px){.card.featured,.card.std,.card.wide{grid-column:span 12}.card.std.offset{margin-top:0}.card.wide{flex-direction:column}.card.wide .media{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--crimson)}.card.wide .body{padding:28px 30px}}

/* ============ PROCESS ============ */
.process-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:30px;margin-bottom:70px}
.process-head p{max-width:42ch;color:var(--muted)}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);position:relative;gap:0}
.steps::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:34px;left:6%;right:6%;height:1px;background:var(--crimson);opacity:.5}
.step{position:relative;padding:0 18px 0 0}
.step .bubble{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ivory);border:1px solid var(--crimson);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--crimson);position:relative;z-index:1;margin-bottom:26px;transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.step:hover .bubble{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory)}
.step h3{margin-bottom:12px}
.step p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;padding-left:34px}
  .steps::before{top:0;bottom:0;left:33px;right:auto;width:1px;height:auto}
  .step{padding:0}
  .step .bubble{position:absolute;left:-34px;margin:0;width:50px;height:50px;font-size:1rem}
  .step{padding-left:30px}
  .step-body{padding-top:4px}
}
.process-note{margin-top:60px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--burgundy);font-size:1.2rem;max-width:60ch}

/* ============ SKILLS ============ */
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:clamp(40px,7vw,100px)}
.skills-head{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(3rem,7vw,5.4rem);line-height:.98;margin:12px 0 0}
.skills-col h3{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--burgundy);font-weight:500;border-bottom:1px solid var(--crimson);padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:6px;font-family:var(--sans);line-height:1.2}
.skill-list{list-style:none;margin-bottom:42px}
.skill-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rose);font-size:1rem;transition:padding .3s,color .3s}
.skill-list li:hover{padding-left:10px;color:var(--crimson)}
.skill-list .lvl{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--mauve)}
.tool-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.tool{border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:20px;background:var(--ivory-2);font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--burgundy);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.tool:hover{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory)}
.tool small{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:.9rem;opacity:.85}
.honest{margin-top:24px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;font-family:var(--serif)}

/* ============ BEYOND ============ */
.beyond-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:60px}
.beyond-head h2{margin-top:10px}
.collage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-auto-rows:240px;gap:22px}
.tile{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--crimson);background:var(--ivory-2);overflow:hidden}
.tile .placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;border:0}
.tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.tile.t1{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2;border-radius:180px 180px 16px 16px}
.tile.t2{grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1;border-radius:14px}
.tile.t3{grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 2;border-radius:14px}
.tile.t4{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 1;border-radius:14px}
.tile .cap{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:12px;background:var(--ivory);border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:6px 12px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--burgundy);z-index:2}
.tile .cap.dark{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory)}
.beyond-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:50px}
@media (max-width:820px){.collage{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:200px}.tile.t1{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2}.tile.t4{grid-column:span 2}}

/* ============ CONTACT ============ */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(40px,6vw,90px);align-items:start}
.contact h2{margin:12px 0 26px}
.contact h2 .crimson{font-style:italic}
.contact-lead{color:var(--muted);max-width:44ch}
.contact-list{display:grid;gap:18px}
.contact-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:20px 22px;background:var(--ivory-2);text-decoration:none;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.contact-item:hover{transform:translateX(6px);box-shadow:-6px 6px 0 var(--rose)}
.contact-item .ico{width:46px;height:46px;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.contact-item .ico svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6}
.contact-item small{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson)}
.contact-item span.v{font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink)}
.contact-item.ph span.v{font-style:italic;font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--muted)}
.contact-cta{margin-top:34px;border:1px solid var(--mauve);background:var(--blush);padding:34px}
.contact-cta p.q{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--burgundy);font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.contact-cta p{color:var(--burgundy);font-size:.96rem}
.contact-cta .btn{margin-top:22px}
footer{padding:50px 0 60px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center}
footer .big{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,4.6rem);font-weight:900;color:rgba(179,38,62,.08);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1}
footer .sign{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1.3rem;margin-top:18px}
footer .copy{margin-top:14px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:900px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============ CASE STUDY ============ */
.case-top{padding:clamp(60px,8vw,110px) 0 40px;position:relative}
.back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--crimson);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:50px;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding-bottom:4px}
.back:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--crimson)}
.case-top h1{font-size:clamp(3.4rem,9vw,7.6rem);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:16px 0 22px}
.case-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.4vw,2rem);color:var(--burgundy);max-width:30ch;line-height:1.25}
.case-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:34px}
.case-hero-img{margin-top:50px;aspect-ratio:21/9;position:relative;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.case-hero-img .placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;border:0}
.case-body{padding:20px 0 120px}
.case-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:60px}
.case-nav{position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}
.case-nav ol{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px;border-left:1px solid var(--rose);padding-left:16px}
.case-nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted)}
.case-nav a:hover{color:var(--crimson)}
.case-sec{padding:44px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rose);scroll-margin-top:110px}
.case-sec:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.case-sec .num{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1rem}
.case-sec h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.4vw,3.4rem);margin:8px 0 22px}
.case-sec p{max-width:66ch;color:var(--charcoal)}
.pull{margin:30px 0;padding:26px 0 26px 30px;border-left:2px solid var(--crimson);font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.4vw,1.9rem);color:var(--burgundy);line-height:1.3;max-width:34ch}
.ph-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:24px}
.ph-grid .placeholder{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.ph-grid .placeholder.tall{aspect-ratio:3/4}
.ph-grid.one{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.ph-grid.one .placeholder{aspect-ratio:16/9}
.principles-list{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:20px;max-width:66ch}
.principles-list li{padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid var(--rose);background:var(--ivory-2);position:relative;padding-left:52px}
.principles-list li::before{content:attr(data-n);position:absolute;left:18px;top:14px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson)}
.status{display:inline-block;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--crimson);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--burgundy)}
.status.exp{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory)}
.note-box{background:var(--blush);border:1px dashed var(--burgundy);padding:18px 22px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--burgundy);margin-top:20px;max-width:66ch}
.case-end{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;margin-top:70px;padding-top:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.case-end .next{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.4vw,2.8rem);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);text-decoration:none}
.case-end .next:hover{text-decoration:underline}
@media (max-width:900px){.case-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}.case-nav{display:none}.ph-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.case-hero-img{aspect-ratio:16/10}}

/* ============ REVEAL & MOTION ============ */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.cursor{position:fixed;width:14px;height:14px;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:200;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .25s,height .25s,background .25s;display:none}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.cursor{display:block}}
.cursor.big{width:42px;height:42px;background:rgba(179,38,62,.08)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-photo{justify-self:center;order:-1;width:min(78%,330px)}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(3.8rem,16vw,6rem)}
  .float-label.a{right:-8px}
  .float-label.b{left:-8px}
  .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .about-visual{max-width:440px;margin:0 auto}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  body{font-size:16px}
  .hero-actions .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .tool-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .about-badge{width:96px;height:96px;font-size:.85rem}
  .about-note{position:relative;left:auto;bottom:auto;margin-top:18px;max-width:none}
  .about-visual{padding:0 0 10px}
  .case-hero-img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none !important;transition:none !important;scroll-behavior:auto !important}
  .reveal,.card{opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important}
}

/* ===== HERO v2 (matched to reference composition) ===== */
.hero2{--hb:#B82943;--hd:#70253A;--hr:#A85B6B;--hl:#D7CAD8;--hbody:#965463;
  position:relative;min-height:calc(100vh - 80px);background:#F8F1EA;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:clamp(40px,6vh,80px) 0}
.h2-g{position:absolute;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.8;color:rgba(184,41,67,.075);pointer-events:none;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;z-index:0;font-size:clamp(8rem,14.5vw,16rem)}
.h2-g.g1{top:-3%;left:-1%}
.h2-g.g2{top:24%;right:-6%}
.h2-g.g3{bottom:-7%;left:-2%}
.h2-dots{position:absolute;top:16%;left:57%;width:112px;height:112px;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,var(--hb) 1.6px,transparent 1.9px);background-size:18px 18px;opacity:.45;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.h2-circle{position:absolute;left:calc(5.3vw - 70px);bottom:12%;width:60px;height:60px;border:1px solid var(--hb);border-radius:50%;opacity:.6;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.h2-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:64% 36%;align-items:center;padding-left:5.3vw;padding-right:5vw}
.h2-left{max-width:720px;padding-right:3vw}
.h2-tilt{display:inline-block;background:#EBD3DA;color:var(--hd);font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.25vw,1.3rem);padding:10px 20px;transform:rotate(-2deg);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(112,37,58,.1);margin-left:2px}
.h2-eyebrow{margin-top:24px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.2vw,1.3rem);color:var(--hd)}
.h2-name{margin-top:12px;font-family:var(--serif);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:900;line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.h2-name .first{display:block;font-size:clamp(3.4rem,8.4vw,9.4rem);color:var(--hb)}
.h2-name .last{display:block;font-size:clamp(3rem,7.2vw,8.2rem);color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.4px var(--hd);margin-top:.04em}
.h2-tag{margin-top:clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px);font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.2vw,2.2rem);line-height:1.3;color:var(--hd);max-width:500px}
.h2-intro{margin-top:clamp(22px,2.6vw,30px);font-size:clamp(1rem,1.05vw,1.1rem);line-height:1.8;color:var(--hbody);max-width:530px}
.h2-foot{margin-top:clamp(30px,4vw,56px);font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.2vw,1.25rem);color:var(--hb)}
.h2-right{position:relative;height:clamp(460px,64vh,580px);width:100%}
.h2-arch{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(430px,88%);aspect-ratio:4/5;transform:translate(-48%,-50%);background:var(--hl);border-radius:240px 240px 0 0;z-index:0}
.h2-back{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(380px,74%);aspect-ratio:4/5;transform:translate(-40%,-42%) rotate(5deg);background:var(--hb);border-radius:0 0 200px 200px;z-index:1}
.h2-ring{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(470px,100%);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:1px dashed rgba(184,41,67,.4);border-radius:50%;z-index:1}
.h2-frame{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-2deg);width:min(380px,70%);aspect-ratio:4/5;background:#FFF9F3;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--hb);border-radius:200px 200px 18px 18px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(112,37,58,.12);z-index:3}
.h2-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%;border-radius:190px 190px 10px 10px}
.h2-lbl{position:absolute;z-index:4;font-family:var(--serif);white-space:nowrap;font-size:clamp(.9rem,1.1vw,1.1rem);line-height:1.2}
.h2-lbl.top{top:4%;right:-2%;background:var(--hb);color:#fff;font-style:italic;padding:8px 14px;transform:rotate(-3deg)}
.h2-lbl.that{top:20%;left:-2%;background:#FFF9F3;color:var(--hb);font-style:italic;border:1px solid var(--hb);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;transform:rotate(-6deg)}
.h2-lbl.bottom{bottom:10%;left:-6%;background:var(--hl);color:var(--hd);border:1px dashed var(--hb);padding:10px 16px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(.85rem,1vw,1rem);transform:rotate(-4deg);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 rgba(112,37,58,.08)}
.h2-marks{position:absolute;right:2.4vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:grid;gap:14px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
.h2-marks span{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--hb)}
.h2-marks span:first-child{background:var(--hb)}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .hero2{min-height:auto;display:block;padding:40px 0 70px}
  .h2-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-left:22px;padding-right:22px;gap:50px}
  .h2-left{max-width:none;padding-right:0}
  .h2-name .first{font-size:clamp(3.6rem,15vw,7rem)}
  .h2-name .last{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,13vw,6.2rem)}
  .h2-right{height:500px;max-width:460px;width:100%;margin:10px auto 0}
  .h2-g,.h2-dots,.h2-circle,.h2-marks{display:none}
  .h2-lbl.top{right:0}
  .h2-lbl.bottom{left:0}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .h2-right{height:440px}
  .h2-lbl.that{left:0}
  .h2-lbl.bottom{bottom:4%}
  .h2-frame{width:72%}
}


/* ===== ABOUT (short version) ===== */
.about-skills{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:26px 0 24px}
.about-skills li{border:1px solid var(--crimson);padding:6px 14px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--burgundy)}
.about-approach{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1.15rem;border-top:1px solid var(--rose);padding-top:18px}
.about-arch img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%}




/* ===== About flower field ===== */
.about-visual{position:relative}
.about-field{position:absolute;inset:-70px -50px -50px -70px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.about-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.about-arch{z-index:1}
.about-badge,.about-note{z-index:3}


/* ===== WHAT I BRING TO THE PROCESS (animated card stack) ===== */
@property --k{syntax:'<number>';inherits:true;initial-value:1}
.wibp{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(90px,11vw,150px) 0;background:var(--ivory)}
.wibp-arc{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(30,26,27,.08);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.wibp-arc.a{width:640px;height:640px;left:-300px;top:-320px}
.wibp-arc.b{width:520px;height:520px;right:-220px;bottom:-260px}
.wibp-head{position:relative;max-width:760px}
.wibp-head h2{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:.98;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.6vw,3.8rem);color:var(--ink);margin-top:10px}
.wibp-lead{margin-top:18px;max-width:58ch;color:var(--muted)}
.wibp-stage{--w:clamp(150px,21vw,240px);--h:clamp(210px,26vw,300px);--amp:1;position:relative;list-style:none;height:clamp(360px,46vw,500px);margin-top:50px;background:var(--ivory);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.wibp-slot{position:absolute;width:var(--w);height:var(--h);left:calc((100% - var(--w)) * var(--t));top:calc((100% - var(--h)) / 2 + var(--dy));z-index:var(--z);transition:--k .5s ease}
.wibp-slot:hover,.wibp-slot.is-focus{z-index:20;--k:.25}
.wibp-move{width:100%;height:100%;animation:wibp-drift var(--dur) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate both}
@keyframes wibp-drift{
  from{transform:translate3d(calc(var(--dx) * var(--amp) * -1),0,0) rotate(calc(var(--r0) * var(--k)))}
  to{transform:translate3d(calc(var(--dx) * var(--amp)),0,0) rotate(calc(var(--r1) * var(--k)))}
}
.wibp-stage:has(.wibp-card:hover) .wibp-move,
.wibp-stage:has(.is-focus) .wibp-move{animation-play-state:paused}
.wibp-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;width:100%;height:100%;padding:22px;background:var(--bg);color:#1E1A1B;border:0;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.28);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .45s ease}
.wibp-slot:hover .wibp-card,.wibp-slot.is-focus .wibp-card{transform:scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 24px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.wibp-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:4px}
.wibp-idx{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}
.wibp-title{margin-top:auto;font-size:clamp(18px,1.9vw,24px);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1}
.wibp-text{margin-top:10px;font-size:clamp(12.5px,1vw,14px);line-height:1.45;color:#3A3335}
.wibp-motif{position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;width:46px;height:46px}
.wibp-motif.m1{border:1.5px solid #1E1A1B;border-radius:50%}
.wibp-motif.m2{border:1.5px solid #1E1A1B;border-bottom:0;border-radius:50px 50px 0 0}
.wibp-motif.m3{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#1E1A1B 1.8px,transparent 2.2px);background-size:11px 11px}
.wibp-motif.m4{border:1.5px solid #1E1A1B;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--bg),0 0 0 7.5px #1E1A1B}
.wibp-motif.m5{top:30px;height:1.5px;background:#1E1A1B}
.wibp-motif.m5::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-2px;top:-4px;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#1E1A1B}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .wibp-stage{--w:clamp(150px,30vw,220px);--h:clamp(220px,36vw,280px)}
}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .wibp-stage{--w:150px;--h:215px;--amp:.5;height:370px;margin-top:36px}
  .wibp-card{padding:16px}
  .wibp-motif{width:36px;height:36px;top:16px;right:16px}
  .wibp-motif.m5{top:24px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .wibp-move{animation:none}
  .wibp-slot,.wibp-card{transition:none}
}


/* ===== WHAT I BRING TO THE TABLE (3D flip cards) ===== */
.flipsec{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(90px,11vw,150px) 0;background:var(--ivory)}
.flipsec .wibp-arc{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(30,26,27,.08);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.flipsec .wibp-arc.a{width:640px;height:640px;left:-300px;top:-320px}
.flipsec .wibp-arc.b{width:520px;height:520px;right:-220px;bottom:-260px}
.flip-head{position:relative;max-width:760px}
.flip-head h2{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:.98;font-size:clamp(2rem,4.6vw,3.8rem);color:var(--ink);margin-top:10px}
.flip-lead{margin-top:18px;max-width:58ch;color:var(--muted)}
.flip-grid{position:relative;list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:22px;margin-top:56px}
.flip-item{min-width:0}
.flip-card{display:block;width:100%;height:var(--ch,340px);padding:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;perspective:1200px;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;border-radius:16px}
.flip-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--crimson);outline-offset:6px}
.flip-inner{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1)}
.flip-card.is-flipped .flip-inner{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.flip-face{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;padding:24px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--bg);color:#1E1A1B;text-align:left;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(30,26,27,.10);transition:box-shadow .75s ease}
.flip-back{transform:rotateY(180deg);background:#FFFCF7;border:1.5px solid var(--bg)}
.flip-top{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.flip-idx{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}
.flip-arrow{font-size:16px;line-height:1;opacity:.7}
.flip-motif{position:absolute;top:58px;right:24px;width:44px;height:44px}
.flip-motif.c1{border:1.5px solid #1E1A1B;border-radius:50%}
.flip-motif.c2{border:1.5px solid #1E1A1B;border-bottom:0;border-radius:50px 50px 0 0}
.flip-motif.c3{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#1E1A1B 1.8px,transparent 2.2px);background-size:11px 11px}
.flip-motif.c4{border:1.5px solid #1E1A1B;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--bg),0 0 0 7.5px #1E1A1B}
.flip-motif.c5{top:70px;height:1.5px;background:#1E1A1B}
.flip-title{margin-top:auto;font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,28px);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1}
.flip-statement{margin-top:12px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;color:#2E2729;font-weight:500}
.flip-title-sm{margin-top:0;font-size:20px}
.flip-text{margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:#3A3335}
.flip-keys{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.flip-key{border:1px solid #1E1A1B;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#1E1A1B}
.flip-return{margin-top:14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson);font-weight:700}
/* Hover flip on pointer devices; tap toggles on touch via .is-flipped */
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .flip-card:hover .flip-inner{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
  .flip-card:hover .flip-face{box-shadow:0 22px 40px rgba(30,26,27,.22)}
}
.flip-card.is-flipped .flip-face{box-shadow:0 22px 40px rgba(30,26,27,.22)}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .flip-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:40px}
  .flip-card{--ch:300px}
  .flip-face{padding:20px}
}
@media (min-width:561px) and (max-width:900px){
  .flip-card{--ch:330px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .flip-inner,.flip-face{transition:none !important}
}


/* ===== BEYOND: compact "Little Things, Lately." ===== */
.bo{background:var(--ivory);padding:clamp(48px,6vw,72px) 0}
.bo-head{max-width:620px}
.bo-eyebrow{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.bo-head h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.2vw,3rem);color:var(--ink);margin-top:8px}
.bo-lead{margin-top:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.bo-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:32px}
.bo-item{min-width:0}
.bo-card{display:block;width:100%;padding:12px;background:#FBF6EE;border:1px solid rgba(112,37,58,.10);border-radius:12px;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .5s ease,border-color .5s ease}
.bo-card:hover{background:#FFFBF5;border-color:rgba(112,37,58,.22)}
.bo-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--crimson);outline-offset:4px}
.bo-media{display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:10px;background:#EFE4D6;color:var(--burgundy);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.bo-media svg{width:44%;height:auto}
.bo-card:hover .bo-media{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.03)}
.bo-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:14px;padding:0 4px}
.bo-num{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted)}
.bo-arrow{font-size:15px;color:var(--crimson);transition:transform .4s ease}
.bo-card:hover .bo-arrow,.bo-card[aria-expanded="true"] .bo-arrow{transform:translateX(4px)}
.bo-title{display:block;margin-top:6px;padding:0 4px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;transition:color .4s ease}
.bo-card:hover .bo-title{color:var(--crimson)}
.bo-desc{display:block;margin-top:6px;padding:0 4px 4px;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted)}
.bo-detail-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .45s ease}
.bo-item.is-open .bo-detail-wrap{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.bo-detail{overflow:hidden;min-height:0;padding:0 16px;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--charcoal);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s ease,padding .45s ease}
.bo-item.is-open .bo-detail{opacity:1;padding:12px 16px 4px}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .bo-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .bo-grid{gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
  .bo-card{padding:10px}
  .bo-title{font-size:1.05rem}
  .bo-desc{font-size:.82rem}
  .bo-detail{font-size:.8rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .bo *{transition:none !important}
}


/* ===== ABOUT ME (layout matched to reference, your content) ===== */
.ab{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#D8C6CC;padding:clamp(90px,10vw,140px) 0}
.ab-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44% 56%;gap:clamp(40px,6vw,100px);align-items:center}
.ab-visual{position:relative;height:clamp(460px,58vw,600px);--ph:clamp(240px,24vw,320px)}
.ab-field{position:absolute;inset:-40px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.ab-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.ab-arch{position:absolute;left:4%;top:4%;width:70%;height:88%;border:1.5px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:220px 220px 14px 14px;background:#B9A6BA;z-index:1}
.ab-ring{position:absolute;left:-2%;top:14%;width:34%;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px dashed rgba(179,38,62,.5);border-radius:50%;z-index:1}
.ab-photo{position:absolute;left:calc(74% - var(--ph) * .8);bottom:6%;width:var(--ph);aspect-ratio:1/1;border:1.5px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#EFE4E8;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(112,37,58,.18);z-index:2}
.ab-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.ab-badge{position:absolute;right:4%;top:6%;width:124px;height:124px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.15;z-index:4;animation:ab-spin 22s linear infinite;padding:18px}
@keyframes ab-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ab-note{position:absolute;left:calc(74% - var(--ph) * .8 + var(--ph) - 40px);bottom:calc(6% + var(--ph) * .12);width:clamp(190px,15vw,215px);max-width:none;background:#FFF9F3;border:1.5px solid var(--crimson);padding:12px 16px;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--burgundy);transform:rotate(-2deg);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--rose);z-index:4}
.ab-pill{position:absolute;left:2%;bottom:calc(6% + var(--ph) * .1);background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;z-index:4;font-size:1rem}
.ab-circle{position:absolute;left:10%;bottom:30%;width:26px;height:26px;border:1px solid var(--crimson);border-radius:50%;z-index:4}
.ab-eyebrow{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:#B0506A;font-size:1.05rem}
.ab-copy h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,4.4vw,4.2rem);color:var(--ink);margin:12px 0 26px}
.ab-em{font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson)}
.ab-copy p{font-size:clamp(1rem,1.1vw,1.1rem);line-height:1.8;color:#7A2E42;margin-top:18px}
.ab-copy h2+p{margin-top:0}
.ab-tags{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:26px}
.ab-tags li{background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);padding:9px 16px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500}
.ab-approach{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson)!important;font-size:1.15rem;margin-top:26px!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(179,38,62,.35);padding-top:16px}
.ab-dots{position:absolute;right:2.2vw;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:grid;gap:14px}
.ab-dots span{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--crimson)}
.ab-dots span.on{background:var(--crimson)}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .ab-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:56px}
  .ab-visual{max-width:520px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;height:520px}
  .ab-dots{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .ab-visual{height:480px;--ph:220px}
  .ab-badge{width:96px;height:96px;font-size:.8rem;padding:12px;right:0}
  .ab-note{font-size:.9rem;width:160px;left:50%;bottom:16px}
  .ab-pill{left:2%;bottom:52%}
  .ab-photo{bottom:130px}
  .ab-circle{display:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .ab-badge{animation:none}
}


/* ===== LET'S CONNECT (contact page layout) ===== */
.lc{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ivory);padding:clamp(80px,9vw,120px) 0}
.lc-grid{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(40px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.lc-left{position:relative}
.lc-eyebrow{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:#B0506A;font-size:1.05rem}
.lc-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-size:clamp(2.75rem,6.4vw,5.8rem);color:var(--ink);margin-top:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.lc-em{font-style:italic;color:var(--crimson)}
.lc-lead{margin-top:20px;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.2vw,1.1rem);line-height:1.7;color:#783A48}
.lc-photo{margin:36px 0 0 6%;width:min(440px,88%);aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 26px 54px rgba(179,38,62,.16);background:#F1E4E4}
.lc-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.lc-star{position:absolute;color:var(--crimson);font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1;pointer-events:none}
.lc-star.s1{top:-10px;right:14%}
.lc-star.s2{left:2%;bottom:14%;font-size:1rem}
.lc-ring{position:absolute;border:1px solid rgba(179,38,62,.4);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.lc-ring.r1{width:70px;height:70px;right:-30px;top:30%}
.lc-ring.r2{width:24px;height:24px;left:44%;bottom:6%}
.lc-right{display:grid;gap:14px;padding-top:6px}
.lc-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(112,37,58,.22);border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;transition:transform .35s ease,border-color .35s ease}
a.lc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--crimson)}
a.lc-card:focus-visible,.lc-cta:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--crimson);outline-offset:4px}
.lc-ico{flex-shrink:0;width:48px;height:48px;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);display:grid;place-items:center}
.lc-ico svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.lc-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.lc-label{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--crimson);font-weight:500}
.lc-value{margin-top:4px;font-size:1rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--ink)}
.lc-invite{position:relative;margin-top:16px;padding:clamp(28px,3.4vw,40px);background:var(--hl,#D9CCD4);border:1px solid rgba(112,37,58,.18);border-radius:4px}
.lc-invite-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.2vw,1.8rem);line-height:1.25;color:var(--burgundy)}
.lc-invite-text{margin-top:14px;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.7;color:#783A48}
.lc-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:24px;padding:15px 26px;background:var(--crimson);color:var(--ivory);text-decoration:none;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;transition:background-color .3s ease}
.lc-cta:hover{background:var(--burgundy)}
.lc-arrow{transition:transform .35s ease}
.lc-cta:hover .lc-arrow{transform:translateX(5px)}
@media (max-width:980px){
  .lc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:56px}
  .lc-title{white-space:normal}
  .lc-photo{margin-left:0;width:min(420px,100%)}
  .lc-ring.r1{right:-10px}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .lc-title{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,12vw,3.6rem)}
  .lc-card{padding:14px 16px;gap:14px}
  .lc-ico{width:42px;height:42px}
  .lc-invite{padding:24px}
  .lc-cta{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .lc-star.s1{right:4%}
  .lc-ring{display:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .lc *{transition:none !important;animation:none !important}
}


/* ===== CONTEXTUAL FLOWERS (fade in only when section is visible) ===== */
.ff-canvas,.ab-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .9s ease;z-index:0}
#process > .wrap,#thinking > .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.wibp .ff-canvas{z-index:0}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .ff-canvas,.ab-canvas{display:none}
}





/* ===== SAATH card: full cover image, never cropped ===== */
.saath-row{margin-top:22px}
.saath-card .media{aspect-ratio:auto;background:#1B1419}
.saath-media img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
@media (max-width:900px){.saath-card .media{aspect-ratio:auto}}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to content</a>
<div class="cursor" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<!-- ============ NAV ============ -->
<header class="nav" role="banner">
  <div class="wrap nav-inner">
    <a href="#home" class="logo" data-route="home" aria-label="Muskan Shaikh, home">M<span>S</span>.</a>
    <button class="menu-btn" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav-links">
      <span></span><span></span><span></span>
    </button>
    <nav aria-label="Primary">
      <ul class="nav-links" id="nav-links">
        <li><a href="#about" data-section="about">About</a></li>
        <li><a href="#work" data-section="work">Work</a></li>
        <li><a href="#thinking" data-section="thinking">Thinking</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact" data-section="contact">Contact</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact" class="nav-cta" data-section="contact">Let's Talk</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="main">

<!-- ============ HOME VIEW ============ -->
<div class="view active" id="view-home" data-view="home">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero2" id="home" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
    <span class="h2-g g1" aria-hidden="true">DESIGN</span>
    <span class="h2-g g2" aria-hidden="true">IDEAS</span>
    <span class="h2-g g3" aria-hidden="true">THINKING</span>
    <span class="h2-dots" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <span class="h2-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span>

    <div class="h2-inner">
      <div class="h2-left">
        <span class="h2-tilt">✦ Interaction Design</span>
        <p class="h2-eyebrow">Hello, world — I'm</p>
        <h1 id="hero-title" class="h2-name">
          <span class="first">Muskan</span>
          <span class="last">Shaikh.</span>
        </h1>
        <p class="h2-tag">I design thoughtful digital<br>experiences for people.</p>
        <p class="h2-intro">I'm a design student specializing in Interaction Design. I explore how people think, behave, and experience digital products, using research, visual design, and prototyping to create thoughtful, intuitive experiences.</p>
        <p class="h2-foot">✦ Interaction Design Student</p>
      </div>

      <div class="h2-right">
        <span class="h2-arch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="h2-ring" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="h2-back" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <div class="h2-frame">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Muskan Shaikh, standing with arms crossed">
        </div>
        <span class="h2-lbl top">UX THINKER ✦</span>
        <span class="h2-lbl that">that's me ✦</span>
        <span class="h2-lbl bottom">INTERACTION<br>DESIGN</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="h2-marks" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  </section>

  <div class="marquee" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="marquee-track">
      <span>Empathy-Driven Design</span><span>UX Research</span><span>Interaction Design</span><span>User Psychology</span><span>Wireframing</span><span>Prototyping</span>
      <span>Empathy-Driven Design</span><span>UX Research</span><span>Interaction Design</span><span>User Psychology</span><span>Wireframing</span><span>Prototyping</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ABOUT -->
  <section class="ab" id="about" aria-labelledby="about-title">
    <div class="wrap ab-grid">
      <div class="ab-visual reveal">
        <div class="ab-field" aria-hidden="true"><canvas class="ab-canvas"></canvas></div>
        <span class="ab-arch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="ab-ring" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <div class="ab-photo">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Illustration of Muskan Shaikh working on her laptop with a cat, coffee, and design books">
        </div>
        <span class="ab-badge" aria-hidden="true">Design · Student · Curious ·</span>
        <span class="ab-note">“Design begins with curiosity.”</span>
        <span class="ab-pill" aria-hidden="true">that's me ✦</span>
        <span class="ab-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </div>

      <div class="ab-copy reveal">
        <span class="ab-eyebrow">// About Me</span>
        <h2 id="about-title">Who am I as a <span class="ab-em">designer?</span></h2>
        <p>I'm a Master's student and aspiring UX designer, curious about people, their behaviour, and the gap between what users need and what a product offers.</p>
        <p>I notice the moments where people hesitate, get confused, or find their own workaround. I ask why it's hard, what they're trying to do, and how it could be better.</p>
        <p>I'm drawn to e-commerce, beauty, and lifestyle products, where discovery and everyday decisions meet. Behind every user journey is a real person with their own priorities.</p>
        <ul class="ab-tags" aria-label="Skills">
          <li>User research</li><li>Observation</li><li>UI design</li><li>Usability testing</li><li>Visual communication</li><li>Experimentation</li>
        </ul>
        <p>Outside design, I dance, do makeup, and cook. Each keeps me observing, experimenting, and paying attention to detail.</p>
        <p class="ab-approach">Observe → Understand → Explore → Test → Refine</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ab-dots" aria-hidden="true"><span class="on"></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  </section>

  <!-- THINKING -->
  <section class="section bg-blush" id="thinking" aria-labelledby="think-title">
    <span class="ghost" style="left:-2%;bottom:-2%;font-size:clamp(7rem,18vw,16rem)" aria-hidden="true">THINK</span>
    <div class="wrap" style="position:relative">
      <div class="think-head reveal">
        <div>
          <span class="label">My Thinking</span>
          <h2 id="think-title">How I <span class="crimson">Think</span><br>About <span class="outline">Design</span></h2>
        </div>
        <p>I don't start with screens. I start with people, and let the problem decide what the solution looks like.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="principles reveal" role="list">
        <article class="principle" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
          <span class="num" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
          <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21c1-4 4-6 8-6s7 2 8 6"/></svg></div>
          <h3>Understand People</h3>
          <p>Before designing a solution, I try to understand the people, context, and behaviours behind the problem.</p>
          <p class="insight">Context shapes behaviour more than we expect.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="principle" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
          <span class="num" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
          <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6"/><path d="M20 20l-4.5-4.5"/></svg></div>
          <h3>Find the Real Problem</h3>
          <p>I look beyond the first obvious complaint to identify what is actually creating friction.</p>
          <p class="insight">The first complaint is rarely the whole story.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="principle" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
          <span class="num" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
          <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 20l4-1 11-11-3-3L5 16z"/><path d="M14 6l3 3"/></svg></div>
          <h3>Explore and Test</h3>
          <p>I use research, sketches, flows, prototypes, and feedback to explore possible directions.</p>
          <p class="insight">Rough sketches are cheap ways to be wrong early.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="principle" role="listitem" tabindex="0">
          <span class="num" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
          <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3l2.6 5.6L20 9.3l-4.3 4 1.2 5.9L12 16.4 6.1 19.2l1.2-5.9-4.3-4 5.4-.7z"/></svg></div>
          <h3>Make It Meaningful</h3>
          <p>I aim to create experiences that feel understandable, useful, and natural to the people using them.</p>
          <p class="insight">Natural usually means it disappeared into the task.</p>
        </article>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- WORK -->
  <section class="section" id="work" aria-labelledby="work-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="work-head reveal">
        <span class="label">// Selected Work</span>
        <h2 id="work-title">A few problems <span class="crimson">I've been</span> <span class="italic">exploring.</span></h2>
        <p>Some of these are developing research projects, some are concepts, and some are built work. Each card says which is which.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="work-grid" id="work-grid">
        <!-- Cards are rendered by script from PROJECTS below, so content lives in one place -->
      </div>

      <div class="work-grid saath-row">
        <a class="card wide saath-card" href="saath-case-study.html" aria-label="SAATH, Go Far. Feel Free. Open the campaign case study">
          <div class="media saath-media">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="SAATH campaign visual: a woman in golden-hour light wearing a gold pill-shaped locket with a purple light">
          </div>
          <div class="body">
            <span class="cat">Campaign Design · Design Communication Ecologies</span>
            <h3>SAATH — Go Far. Feel Free.</h3>
            <p class="problem">A campaign concept for women's safety and freedom of movement, built around a discreet wearable locket.</p>
            <p class="summary">Campaign strategy, visual identity, art direction, and campaign touchpoints.</p>
            <div class="meta"><span>Campaign Design</span><span>Design Communication Ecologies</span></div>
            <span class="view-link">View Case Study →</span>
          </div>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- PROCESS -->
  <section class="section bg-blush" aria-labelledby="process-title">
    <span class="ghost" style="right:-2%;top:4%;font-size:clamp(6rem,15vw,13rem)" aria-hidden="true">PROCESS</span>
    <div class="wrap" style="position:relative">
      <div class="process-head reveal">
        <div>
          <span class="label">// How I Work</span>
          <h2 id="process-title">My <span class="crimson">process</span>, roughly</h2>
        </div>
        <p>Projects rarely move in a straight line. These five stages are how I usually find my way, not a rule I follow perfectly.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="steps reveal">
        <div class="step"><div class="bubble">i</div><div class="step-body"><h3>Observe</h3><p>Watch what people actually do, and notice where it differs from what they say.</p></div></div>
        <div class="step"><div class="bubble">ii</div><div class="step-body"><h3>Define</h3><p>Turn a messy situation into a sharper question worth designing for.</p></div></div>

        "At what point does a decision feel 'good enough' to commit to?",
        "What would make a recommendation feel trustworthy rather than restrictive?"
      ]},
      { t: "Research methods & evidence", p: [
        "[PLACEHOLDER: describe the methods you actually used, such as interviews, diary study, or observation. Include sample size only if it is accurate.]"
      ], placeholder: "Add: interview notes, diary excerpts, or photos of your research board" },
      { t: "Key observations & insights", p: [
        "[PLACEHOLDER: add observations you recorded. Do not add conclusions you have not checked against your data.]"
      ]},
      { t: "Problem definition", p: [
        "How might we help someone make a daily outfit decision quickly and with confidence, without repeatedly restarting the process?"
      ]},
      { t: "Design principles", p: [], list: [
        "Keep the decision short and reversible.",
        "Offer one clear suggestion before asking for more input.",
        "Make small changes easy, so people don't have to start over."
      ]},
      { t: "Ideation & alternatives", p: [
        "I explored several directions: a full styling assistant, a wardrobe-browsing tool, and a focused recommendation with small adjustments. I'm currently leaning toward the most focused one."
      ]},
      { t: "Information architecture & user flow", p: [
        "The core flow is short: open, see one recommendation, then choose between accepting it or changing one thing."
      ], placeholder: "Add: user flow diagram" },
      { t: "Wireframes & visual design", p: [
        "Interaction concept: 'Today, wear this' as the main action, and 'Change one thing' as the secondary action. [PLACEHOLDER: add wireframes]"
      ], placeholder: "Add: wireframe screens" },
      { t: "Prototype", p: ["[PLACEHOLDER: link or screens of your prototype, if you have one]"] },
      { t: "Testing & feedback", p: ["[PLACEHOLDER: add testing only if it happened. If not, leave this as 'not yet tested'.]"] },
      { t: "Limitations & open questions", p: [
        "This is an early exploration. I have not validated the concept with users, and I'm not claiming it reduces decision fatigue. The open question is whether the simplified flow actually feels better in use."
      ]},
      { t: "What I learned", p: ["[PLACEHOLDER: a personal reflection on what this project taught you about research or decision-making]"] },
      { t: "Future opportunities", p: ["Testing the flow with real users, and exploring how the recommendation changes across seasons, occasions, and moods."] }
    ]
  }

];

/* ---------------- Render work cards ---------------- */
const grid = document.getElementById('work-grid');
grid.innerHTML = PROJECTS.map(p => {
  const classes = `card ${p.cardType}`;
  return `
  <a class="${classes}" href="#work/${p.id}" aria-label="Open case study: ${p.title}">
    <div class="media">
      <img src="${p.image}" alt="" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
      <div class="placeholder"><div><b>Project image</b>Add screenshots or a mockup</div></div>
      <span class="pnum" aria-hidden="true">${p.num}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="body">
      <span class="cat">${p.category}</span>
      <h3>${p.title}</h3>
      <p class="problem">${p.problem}</p>
      <p class="summary">${p.summary}</p>
      <div class="meta"><span>${p.role}</span><span><span class="status">${p.status}</span></span></div>
      <span class="view-link">View Case Study →</span>
    </div>
  </a>`;
}).join('');

/* ---------------- Case study renderer ---------------- */
function renderCase(id) {
  const p = PROJECTS.find(x => x.id === id);
  if (!p) return false;
  const idx = PROJECTS.indexOf(p);
  const next = PROJECTS[(idx + 1) % PROJECTS.length];

  document.getElementById('case-top').innerHTML = `
    <a class="back" href="#work">← Back to work</a>
    <span class="label">Project ${p.num}</span>
    <h1>${p.title}</h1>
    <p class="case-sub">${p.subtitle}</p>
    <div class="case-meta">
      <span class="status ${p.status.includes('Built') ? 'exp' : ''}">${p.status}</span>
      <span class="tag">${p.category}</span>
      <span class="tag">Role: ${p.role}</span>
      <span class="tag">${p.duration}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="case-hero-img">
      <img src="${p.image}" alt="" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
      <div class="placeholder"><div><b>Hero image</b>Add the main visual for this project</div></div>
    </div>`;

  const nav = p.sections.map((s, i) => `<li><a href="#s${i}">${s.t}</a></li>`).join('');

  const body = p.sections.map((s, i) => {
    const paras = s.p.map(x => `<p>${x}</p>`).join('');
    const list = s.list ? `<ol class="principles-list">${s.list.map((x, n) => `<li data-n="${String(n + 1).padStart(2, '0')}">${x}</li>`).join('')}</ol>` : '';
    const pull = s.pull ? `<blockquote class="pull">${s.pull}</blockquote>` : '';
    const ph = s.placeholder ? `<div class="ph-grid one"><div class="placeholder"><div><b>[Image placeholder]</b>${s.placeholder}</div></div></div>` : '';
    return `
    <section class="case-sec" id="s${i}">
      <span class="num">${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
      <h2>${s.t}</h2>
      ${paras}${pull}${list}${ph}
    </section>`;
  }).join('');

  document.getElementById('case-body').innerHTML = `
    <div class="case-grid">
      <aside class="case-nav" aria-label="Case study sections"><ol>${nav}</ol></aside>
      <article>${body}
        <div class="case-end">
          <a class="back" href="#work">← All work</a>
          <a class="next" href="#work/${next.id}">Next: ${next.title} →</a>
        </div>
      </article>
    </div>`;
  return true;
}

/* ---------------- Routing ---------------- */
const homeView = document.getElementById('view-home');
const caseView = document.getElementById('view-case');

function showHome(targetId) {
  caseView.classList.remove('active');
  homeView.classList.add('active');
  if (targetId) {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    });
  } else {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }
  observeReveals();
}

function route() {
  const hash = location.hash.replace('#', '');
  if (hash.startsWith('work/')) {
    const id = hash.split('/')[1];
    if (renderCase(id)) {
      homeView.classList.remove('active');
      caseView.classList.add('active');
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' in window ? 'instant' : 'auto' });
      setActive('work');
      return;
    }
  }
  if (hash === '' || hash === 'home') {
    showHome(null);
    setActive(null);
    return;
  }
  // a section anchor like #about, #work, #contact
  if (homeView.classList.contains('active') === false) homeView.classList.add('active');
  caseView.classList.remove('active');
  showHome(hash);
  setActive(hash);
}

function setActive(section) {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(a => {
    a.classList.toggle('active', a.dataset.section === section);
  });
}

window.addEventListener('hashchange', route);

/* ---------------- Mobile menu ---------------- */
const menuBtn = document.querySelector('.menu-btn');
const navLinks = document.getElementById('nav-links');
function closeMenu() {
  navLinks.classList.remove('open');
  menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
}
menuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const open = !navLinks.classList.contains('open');
  navLinks.classList.toggle('open', open);
  menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
  menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
});
navLinks.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.closest('a')) closeMenu(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu(); });

/* ---------------- Reveal on scroll & staggered cards ---------------- */
let io;
function observeReveals() {
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal,.card').forEach(el => el.classList.add('in'));
    return;
  }
  if (!io) {
    io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(en => {
        if (en.isIntersecting) {
          const el = en.target;
          if (el.classList.contains('card')) {
            const i = [...grid.children].indexOf(el);
            el.style.transitionDelay = (i % 2) * 120 + 'ms';
          }
          el.classList.add('in');
          io.unobserve(el);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal:not(.in),.card:not(.in)').forEach(el => io.observe(el));
}

/* ---------------- Active nav on scroll ---------------- */
const sectionIds = ['about', 'work', 'thinking', 'process', 'contact'];
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  if (!homeView.classList.contains('active')) return;
  const y = window.scrollY + window.innerHeight * 0.35;
  let current = null;
  sectionIds.forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el && el.offsetTop <= y) current = id;
  });
  setActive(current);
}, { passive: true });

/* ---------------- Custom cursor (pointer devices only, decorative) ---------------- */
const cursor = document.querySelector('.cursor');
if (cursor && matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    cursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    cursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  });
  document.addEventListener('mouseover', e => {
    cursor.classList.toggle('big', !!e.target.closest('a,button,.card,.principle'));
  });
}

/* ---------------- Init ---------------- */
const yearEl = document.getElementById('year');
if (yearEl) yearEl.textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
route();
observeReveals();
</script>

<script>

/* ---- Shared cursor-reactive particle field ---- */
(function(){
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const CREAM = '#F4E9DC';
  const COLORS = ['#B82943','#D9854B','#7F9CC4','#70253A','#E7A3B0','#C0603A'];
  const ALL_TYPES = ['flower','flower','star','dot','dot','diamond'];
  const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  window.createField = createField;
  const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

  function createField(cfg){
    const canvas = cfg.canvas, container = cfg.container, listen = cfg.listen;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const density = cfg.density ?? 0.5;
    const spacing = cfg.spacing ?? 26;
    const types = cfg.types || ALL_TYPES;
    const scale = cfg.scale ?? 1;
    const R = cfg.radius ?? 180;

    let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, parts = [], raf = null, visible = true;
    let px = -9999, py = -9999, active = false, touching = false;
    let strength = 0, lastMove = 0;

    function build(){
      const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      W = r.width; H = r.height;
      DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
      canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
      ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
      const sp = W < 600 ? spacing + 4 : spacing;
      const dens = W < 600 ? density * 0.5 : density;
      parts = [];
      for (let y = sp / 2; y < H; y += sp) {
        for (let x = sp / 2; x < W; x += sp) {
          if (Math.random() > dens) continue;
          const hx = x + rnd(-5, 5), hy = y + rnd(-5, 5);
          parts.push({
            hx, hy, x: hx, y: hy, vx: 0, vy: 0,
            k: rnd(0.03, 0.08),
            seed: Math.random(),
            ring: rnd(14, 70) * scale,
            rot: rnd(0, TAU), spin: rnd(-0.01, 0.01),
            size: rnd(4, 9) * scale,
            type: types[(Math.random() * types.length) | 0],
            color: COLORS[(Math.random() * COLORS.length) | 0]
          });
        }
      }
    }

    function step(now){
      if (now - lastMove > 1600 && !touching) active = false;
      strength += ((active ? 1 : 0) - strength) * 0.07;
      for (const p of parts) {
        let tx = p.hx, ty = p.hy;
        if (strength > 0.002) {
          const d = Math.hypot(p.hx - px, p.hy - py);
          if (d < R) {
            const inf = Math.pow(1 - d / R, 1.4) * strength;
            const a = p.seed * TAU + now * 0.0004 * (0.5 + p.seed);
            tx += (px + Math.cos(a) * p.ring - tx) * inf;
            ty += (py + Math.sin(a) * p.ring - ty) * inf;
          }
        }
        p.vx = (p.vx + (tx - p.x) * p.k) * 0.84;
        p.vy = (p.vy + (ty - p.y) * p.k) * 0.84;
        p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
        p.rot += p.spin + (Math.abs(p.vx) + Math.abs(p.vy)) * 0.03;
      }
    }

    function isSettled(){
      if (active || strength > 0.002) return false;
      for (const p of parts) {
        if (Math.abs(p.vx) > 0.02 || Math.abs(p.vy) > 0.02 ||
            Math.abs(p.x - p.hx) > 0.3 || Math.abs(p.y - p.hy) > 0.3) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }

    function draw(){
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      for (const p of parts) {
        const s = p.size;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.rotate(p.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        switch (p.type) {
          case 'flower':
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
              const a = i * 1.2566;
              const cx = Math.cos(a) * s * 0.55, cy = Math.sin(a) * s * 0.55;
              ctx.moveTo(cx + s * 0.36, cy);
              ctx.arc(cx, cy, s * 0.36, 0, TAU);
            }
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = CREAM;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.22, 0, TAU);
            ctx.fill();
            break;
          case 'star':
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
              const r = i % 2 ? s * 0.45 : s * 0.9;
              const a = i * 0.6283 - Math.PI / 2;
              ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
            }
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            break;
          case 'diamond':
            ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(s * 0.6, 0);
            ctx.lineTo(0, s * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.6, 0);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            break;
          default:
            ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.3, 0, TAU);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    function frame(now){
      step(now);
      draw();
      if (!visible || isSettled()) { raf = null; return; }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    function kick(){
      if (reduce || raf || !visible) return;
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    function localPoint(e){
      const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      return [e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top];
    }
    function inside(){
      return px > -40 && px < W + 40 && py > -40 && py < H + 40;
    }

    listen.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
      if (reduce) return;
      if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' && !touching) return;
      [px, py] = localPoint(e);
      active = inside();
      lastMove = performance.now();
      kick();
    });
    listen.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
      if (reduce || e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
      touching = true;
      [px, py] = localPoint(e);
      active = inside();
      lastMove = performance.now();
      kick();
    });
    const endTouch = () => { touching = false; lastMove = performance.now(); };
    listen.addEventListener('pointerup', endTouch);
    listen.addEventListener('pointercancel', endTouch);
    listen.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { if (!touching) { active = false; kick(); } });

    new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      visible = entries[0].isIntersecting;
      canvas.style.opacity = visible ? '1' : '0';
      if (visible) kick();
    }, { threshold: 0.12 }).observe(container);

    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => { build(); draw(); kick(); }, 150);
    });

    build();
    draw();
    kick();
  }

  // About: lighter field of flowers and stars around the portrait
  const aboutVisual = document.querySelector('.ab-visual');
  if (aboutVisual) {
    createField({
      canvas: aboutVisual.querySelector('.ab-canvas'),
      container: aboutVisual,
      listen: aboutVisual,
      density: 0.2,
      spacing: 30,
      types: ['flower', 'flower', 'star'],
      scale: 0.85,
      radius: 130
    });
  }
})();
</script>


<script>
/* Tap / click to focus a card on touch and keyboard. Pauses the stack while one is focused. */
(function(){
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.wibp-card');
  cards.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const slot = btn.closest('.wibp-slot');
      const wasOn = slot.classList.contains('is-focus');
      document.querySelectorAll('.wibp-slot.is-focus').forEach(s => {
        s.classList.remove('is-focus');
        s.querySelector('.wibp-card').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      });
      if (!wasOn) {
        slot.classList.add('is-focus');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>


<script>
/* Tap or click toggles a card on touch and keyboard. Hover flips on pointer devices. */
(function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.flip-card').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const on = !btn.classList.contains('is-flipped');
      btn.classList.toggle('is-flipped', on);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
    });
  });
})();
</script>







</body>
</html>
